limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation was not accessed or run.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation: positive-edge D capture with active-high asynchronous reset to zero; no subsequent RTL revisions.
justified_tb_changes: Initial independent directed testbench checks uninitialized storage, both data values, hold behavior, asynchronous reset at both clock levels, reset priority, reset release, and simultaneous reset/clock assertion. No subsequent testbench changes.
interface_cycle_contract: TopModule(clk, ar, d, q), all one-bit; q captures d on rising clk when ar is low, and clears to zero asynchronously when ar is asserted.
numeric_width_decisions: All ports and stored data are one bit.
pipeline_latency_and_ii: Single D flip-flop; capture on each positive clock edge, no added latency.
static_review_result: Single always_ff driver, nonblocking assignments, exact required ports and asynchronous reset sensitivity.
